name: Punjab Education Endowment Fund (PEEF) Undergraduate Scholarship
name_ur: پنجاب ایجوکیشن انڈومنٹ فنڈ انڈرگریجویٹ اسکالرشپ
provider: Punjab Education Endowment Fund (PEEF), Government of Punjab
target_group: Punjab-domicile students entering undergraduate study straight after Intermediate
summary_en: A merit-and-need scholarship for Punjab-domicile students who scored well in Intermediate and come from a lower-income household, covering a monthly stipend for undergraduate study.
summary_ur: پنجاب ڈومیسائل رکھنے والے طلباء کے لیے میرٹ اور ضرورت پر مبنی اسکالرشپ، جو انٹرمیڈیٹ میں اچھے نمبر رکھتے ہوں اور کم آمدنی والے گھرانے سے تعلق رکھتے ہوں۔

eligibility_conditions.special_quota_note: Children of BPS 1-4 government employees and children of civilians martyred in terrorist attacks are exempt from the income condition. Special quota also exists for orphans, minorities, and disabled students.

required_documents: Proof of full-time admission at a partner university/institution
Income certificate (parent/guardian, from Tehsildar or employer as applicable)
application_steps: Check PEEF's current-year scholarship announcement and application window
Secure full-time admission at a PEEF partner institution
Gather domicile, income, and educational documents
Submit the application via the PEEF portal or the designated institutional PEEF focal point
Await shortlisting/merit list and respond to any verification requests before the deadline
disclaimer: Eligibility details were confirmed against the official source on 2026-09-12. The application deadline shown is a provisional placeholder for the expected cycle, not a date the authority has announced - confirm it on the official page before applying.
